title: Missing slippage protection in deposit/redeem functions
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The `HyperVaultRouter` contract implements a vault system where users can deposit various assets and receive share tokens in return. The share calculation in the `deposit()` function relies on the USD value of deposited assets, which is determined by querying rates from the escrow contract.
